'''Lock-picking kits'''<ref name="HR" /> or '''lock-breaking kits'''<ref name="PP" /> were specialist [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kits]] used by [[Spy/Legends|spies]], intelligence [[Agent/Legends|agents]],<ref name="HR" /> [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] and [[Shipjacker/Legends|shipjackers]].<ref name="PP" /> They were employed to bypass [[Lock/Legends|locks]] and other physical security means.<ref name="HR" /> Most kits were self built using components from other tool kits, with the addition of specialist and rare components purchased from security manufacturers.<ref name="PP" />
